findings.desc: terminalStopEvent adjudicate.mjs:190 — the branch `ev.terminal === true && typeof kind === string` accepts any event object carrying `terminal:true` plus ANY string type/event/kind field (including edit, info, log, etc.) as a terminal-stop event, instead of restricting to TERMINAL_STOP_TYPES. This contradicts the function comment ("qualifies if its type field is one of those three terminal kinds") and §4.2 (stop/rollback/human_gate only). A process event {terminal:true, type:edit} would produce safe-stop rather than null, silently widening the stop-event definition beyond spec. Selfcheck has no test for this case.
